name: Pricing Management
description: Independent entity-owned price lists, immutable proposals, separate human reviews and activation, deterministic resolution and historical evidence. No external publishing or payment execution.

fields.name: validUntil
fields.label: Requested validity end (before current price and cost leases)

actions.label: Record analytical review and publish at quorum
actions.confirmation: Record your review of this exact prospective price and cost evidence? Publication waits for the required distinct current reviewers and separation of duties. This publishes a bounded immutable snapshot only and grants no price, financial, purchasing or production authority. Source and current reviewer permissions are checked again.

actions.label: Withdraw analytical snapshot
actions.confirmation: Withdraw this analytical disclosure for future current views? Retained source facts, historical publication evidence and accepted transaction prices remain unchanged.

actions.label: Activate approved price
actions.confirmation: Activate this exact price revision only if its current approval policy and independent reviews remain valid? Existing accepted transaction prices remain unchanged.

actions.label: Deactivate price
actions.confirmation: Deactivate this price for new resolutions? Existing accepted transaction snapshots remain unchanged.

costMaxAgeSeconds.description: Maximum accepted cost observation age; original source leases and human assumption validity are never extended.

integrationsEnabled.description: Enable explicitly approved Catalog read capabilities. Standalone SKU pricing remains available without Catalog.

catalogMaxAgeSeconds.description: Maximum age of a cached Catalog observation. Cached evidence does not prove current external state.
